title: Corsa PRO Tube-Type
notes: Official store read 2026-11-01 (EUR): 700x26c 245 g, 28c 255 g, 30c 270 g, EUR 87.95 each, Cotton Tan. Claims ultimate cornering grip in wet or dry conditions and, versus the previous Corsa tube-type, 12% better rolling efficiency, 18% more puncture resistance and 9% less weight.
